title: MQTT 入門：訊息如何找到對的人？
learning_goal: 看完能說明「發布者 → Broker → 訂閱者」的流程，並能為一個教室監測情境設計 Topic、選擇 QoS。
audience: 高中職／大一 IoT 入門

approval.evidence: 2026-10-07 使用者回覆「用 Charon，樣片和大綱都OK，開始正式製作」；片長改為 300 秒亦經使用者選擇

sources.title: The History of MQTT Part 1: The Origin（HiveMQ）
OASIS MQTT Internet of Things Standard Now Approved by ISO/IEC JTC1
MQTT（Wikipedia，用於交叉核對 3.1.1 發布日 2014-10-29）
The Eclipse Foundation Announces Sparkplug as an International Standard

origin.summary: 1999 年 IBM 的 Andy Stanford-Clark 與 Arcom 的 Arlen Nipper 為衛星監控石油管線設計 MQTT；2010 年 3.1 免權利金公開；2014-10-29 MQTT 3.1.1 成為 OASIS 標準，之後成為 ISO/IEC 20922；2019-03-07 MQTT 5.0。

principle.summary: 發布／訂閱透過 Broker 轉交；Topic 以斜線分層，+ 單層、# 多層萬用字元；QoS 0/1/2；Retain 與 Last Will。

comparison.summary: 同一任務（手機即時看溫度）比較 HTTP/1.1 輪詢與 MQTT 3.1.1 推送：通訊模式、連線、通知方式、標頭、適用情境。
comparison.conditions: 依協定規格比較，非實測效能

application.summary: 真實：2011 Facebook Messenger 以 MQTT 維持手機長連線。示範：教室監測（QoS 0 溫度、QoS 1 冷氣指令、LWT 離線通知、school/+/temp），限制：Broker 集中點、公開 Broker 不可傳私密資料、需帳密與 TLS。

outlook.summary: MQTT 5.0 已發布功能；Sparkplug 3.0 於 2023 年成為 ISO/IEC 20237；MQTT over QUIC 屬廠商實驗功能（research）；百萬裝置的安全與管理為待解問題（inference）。

text: 想像教室裡有三十個感測器，
Imagine a classroom with thirty sensors:
溫度、濕度、二氧化碳，
temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide.
每一筆資料都要同時送到手機、網頁和資料庫。
Every reading must reach a phone, a web page and a database at once.
如果每個裝置都和每個接收端直接連線，
If every device connected directly to every receiver,
線路很快就會亂成一張蜘蛛網。
the links would soon tangle into a spider web.
有沒有更好的方法？
Is there a better way?
答案之一，就是 MQTT。
One answer is MQTT.
1999 年，IBM 的 Andy Stanford-Clark
In 1999, Andy Stanford-Clark of IBM
和 Arcom 公司的 Arlen Nipper，
and Arlen Nipper of Arcom
為了透過衛星監控石油管線，設計出這個協定。
designed this protocol to monitor oil pipelines via satellite.
當時衛星頻寬很貴、連線不穩定，
Satellite bandwidth was expensive and links were unstable,
現場裝置的電力也有限，
and field devices had limited power,
所以它必須又輕、又省、又可靠。
so it had to be lightweight, efficient and reliable.
2010 年，規格免費公開；
In 2010, the specification was released royalty-free;
2014 年成為 OASIS 標準，
in 2014 it became an OASIS standard,
後來也成為 ISO 國際標準；
and later an ISO international standard;
2019 年，推出 MQTT 5.0。
in 2019, MQTT 5.0 was released.
MQTT 的核心是「發布與訂閱」。
At the heart of MQTT is publish/subscribe.
中間有一台伺服器，叫做 Broker，
In the middle sits a server called the Broker,
也就是訊息代理人。
the message broker.
感測器是發布者，它只要把資料送到一個「主題」，
The sensor is a publisher; it just sends data to a “topic”,
例如 101 教室的溫度，不需要知道誰會收到。
such as Room 101's temperature, without knowing who will receive it.
手機和網頁是訂閱者，
The phone and the web page are subscribers.
事先告訴 Broker 自己關心哪些主題；
They tell the Broker in advance which topics they care about.
Broker 一收到新訊息，就複製一份轉交給它們。
When a new message arrives, the Broker forwards a copy to each.
雙方完全不必知道彼此的位址。
Neither side needs to know the other's address.
主題像資料夾一樣，用斜線分層：
Topics are layered with slashes, like folders:
學校、教室、感測項目。
school, classroom, sensor type.
訂閱時可以使用萬用字元。
When subscribing, you can use wildcards.
加號「+」代表「任意一層」，
The plus sign “+” matches any single level,
所以 school/+/temp
so school/+/temp
會收到每一間教室的溫度。
receives the temperature of every classroom.
井字號「#」代表「這一層以下的全部」，
The hash “#” matches everything below that level,
而且只能放在最後；
and it can only go at the end;
school/room101/# 就是這間教室的所有資料。
school/room101/# means all data from that room.
網路不一定可靠，所以 MQTT 提供三種服務品質，簡稱 QoS。
Networks aren't always reliable, so MQTT offers three Quality of Service levels.
QoS 0，最多送一次，送出就不管，
QoS 0: at most once — send and forget,
最省資源，但可能遺失。
cheapest, but messages may be lost.
QoS 1，至少送一次，收到的一方要回覆確認，
QoS 1: at least once — the receiver must acknowledge,
沒收到確認就重送，所以可能重複。
and without an acknowledgment it resends, so duplicates can happen.
QoS 2，剛好一次，用四個步驟確認，
QoS 2: exactly once, confirmed in four steps —
最可靠，但也最慢、最耗流量。
the most reliable, but also the slowest and most costly.
要依資料的重要性來選擇。
Choose based on how important the data is.
還有兩個實用功能。
Two more handy features.
保留訊息：Broker 會記住主題的最後一筆值，
Retained messages: the Broker remembers a topic's last value,
新的訂閱者一連上，就立刻知道目前狀態。
so a new subscriber learns the current state immediately.
遺囑訊息：裝置連線時先留下一段遺言；
Last Will: a device leaves a “will” when it connects;
萬一它意外斷線，Broker 會代為發布「已離線」，
if it drops off unexpectedly, the Broker publishes “offline” for it,
讓大家知道。
so everyone knows.
和網頁常用的 HTTP 比一比。
Let's compare it with HTTP, the protocol of the web.
同樣要讓手機即時看到溫度：
Same task: show the temperature on a phone in real time.
HTTP 是請求與回應，手機得一再詢問「有新資料嗎？」，
HTTP is request–response: the phone keeps asking “Any new data?”
每次都帶著一長串文字標頭。
carrying a long text header every time.
MQTT 則維持一條長連線，
MQTT keeps one long-lived connection;
有新資料時由 Broker 主動推送，
when new data arrives, the Broker pushes it,
固定標頭最小只有兩個位元組。
and the fixed header can be as small as two bytes.
HTTP 工具成熟，適合網頁和檔案傳輸；
HTTP has mature tools and suits web pages and file transfer;
MQTT 則適合頻寬小、裝置多、需要即時通知的物聯網。
MQTT suits IoT: low bandwidth, many devices, instant notifications.
MQTT 早就用在真實產品中，
MQTT is already used in real products.
例如 2011 年的 Facebook Messenger，
In 2011, Facebook Messenger
就用它維持手機的長連線。
used it to keep a persistent connection on phones.
來看一個示範情境：教室環境監測。
Now a demonstration scenario: classroom monitoring.
ESP32 每十秒用 QoS 0 發布溫度，
An ESP32 publishes the temperature every ten seconds at QoS 0;
偶爾少一筆沒有關係。
missing a reading now and then is fine.
冷氣開關的指令比較重要，改用 QoS 1；
Air-conditioner commands matter more, so they use QoS 1;
裝置也設定遺囑訊息，一斷線，畫面就顯示離線。
the device also sets a Last Will, so the screen shows “offline” if it drops.
結果，老師只要訂閱一個加號主題，
As a result, by subscribing to a single “+” topic,
就能在手機上看到所有教室，還能遠端控制。
the teacher sees every classroom on a phone and can control them remotely.
但要注意：Broker 是集中點，需要備援；
But note: the Broker is a central point and needs redundancy;
公開的測試 Broker 不能傳私密資料，
never send private data through a public test Broker;
正式使用要加上帳號密碼與 TLS 加密。
real deployments need usernames, passwords and TLS encryption.
展望未來，MQTT 5.0 加入了原因碼、
Looking ahead, MQTT 5.0 added reason codes,
共享訂閱和訊息到期等功能，讓大型系統更容易管理。
shared subscriptions and message expiry, making large systems easier to manage.
在工廠裡，建立在 MQTT 之上的 Sparkplug 規範，
In factories, the Sparkplug specification, built on MQTT,
已在 2023 年成為國際標準。
became an international standard in 2023.
也有廠商正在實驗以 QUIC 取代 TCP，
Some vendors are experimenting with QUIC instead of TCP
讓不穩定的網路更快重新連線。
to reconnect faster on unstable networks.
不過，面對數以百萬計的裝置，
Yet with millions of devices,
安全與管理仍是待解的挑戰。
security and management remain open challenges.
記住一句話：發布者只管送到主題，
Remember this: publishers just send to a topic,
Broker 負責轉交，訂閱者只收自己關心的。
the Broker delivers, and subscribers get only what they care about.
這，就是 MQTT。
That is MQTT.
